profile.headline: Senior Software Developer @ American Express | Building Scalable AWS Solutions
profile.summary:
I’m a Senior Software Engineer and AWS Cloud professional with 10+ years of experience designing, developing, modernizing, and supporting scalable enterprise applications and cloud-based solutions.

My core expertise is in Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, REST APIs, AWS, and event-driven architectures, with hands-on experience building highly available and scalable applications across distributed environments.

Throughout my career, I’ve worked across the complete software development lifecycle—from solution design and application development to cloud migration, API integration, deployment, monitoring, and production support. I have experience modernizing legacy applications into cloud-native and microservices-based architectures while focusing on scalability, security, reliability, and performance.

My technical experience includes:
• Backend & Microservices: Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, Microservices, Python, Node.js
• AWS & Cloud: Lambda, API Gateway, EC2, ECS/Fargate, EKS, S3, RDS/Aurora, DynamoDB, SQS, SNS, Kinesis, CloudWatch, IAM, VPC etc
• Messaging & Event-Driven Systems: Apache Kafka, SQS/SNS, Kinesis, Pub/Sub
• Containers & Infrastructure: Docker, Kubernetes/EKS, Terraform, CloudFormation, CI/CD
• Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle, Cassandra, MongoDB, DynamoDB
• Frontend: React, Angular, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS
• Data & Distributed Processing: Apache Beam, Apache Flink, Airflow, Spark
• Engineering Practices: Object-Oriented Design, Design Patterns, API Design, Agile/Scrum, CI/CD, automated testing, observability, and production troubleshooting.

I enjoy solving complex engineering problems, designing systems that can scale reliably, and working with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into practical technical solutions.
I hold a Master’s degree in Computer Science from Marshall University and continuously expand my expertise in cloud architecture, distributed systems, and modern software engineering.
Areas of Focus:
AWS Cloud Architecture | Java | Spring Boot | Microservices | REST APIs | Kafka | Event-Driven Architecture | Kubernetes | Terraform | Serverless | Distributed Systems | Cloud Modernization

positions.title: AWS Developer / Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
•	Architect, Develop and maintain high-quality enhancements and additional subsystems to our flagship products based on the open-source software model.
•	Writing scalable & serverless services in AWS lambda using Node js.
•	Working on AWS services like S3, API Gateway, DynamoDB, Lambda Functions and CloudWatch for better performance.
•	Worked on AngularJS for front end development.
•	Developed REST web services using Node js to perform some of important task used in application and combined with api gateway of amazon web services.
•	Worked on Google maps API & Expericance.com reviews API to get reviews for different user on our application.
•	Working on databases like MySQL & DynamoDB to perform activities and sync company data aligned.
•	Write high-performance, concurrent node.js code that powers all of our APIs
•	Writing code in javascript & jquery for webflow platform.
•	Working in small team with Agile & scrum based projects.
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Node.js · REST API · Webflow · Python (Programming Language) · MySQL · PostgreSQL

positions.title: Full Stack Developer / AWS Developer
positions.description:
•   Designed and configured the appropriate solution to meet all requirements and ensure that client expectations are fulfilled regarding platform use cases and functionality. 
•   Defines product requirements and creates high level architectural specifications, ensuring feasibility and functionality with existing platforms
•   Working on the Automation of our personalized 1:1 marketing flyers, banners, and catalogs using proprietary imaging server, Core24 color logic and ImageMagick API in just one click for all clients.
•    Worked on Node js with typescript and databases like sql.
•  Worked on restful webservices using node js and mongoDB.
•  Working extensilvely with AWS cloud services like EC2, S3, VPC, ELB, RDS, Cloud watch etc.
•   Developing and consuming web services for our platform using REST and SOAP, and also new APIs for integration with magento Ecommerce application.
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Node.js · PHP · SQL · REST API · MySQL

positions.title: AWS Developer / Full stack developer
positions.description:
At Cynch, I am responsible for using the latest technology to architect, build and deliver solutions for clients from real estate industry like Lakehouse.com, Beachhouse.com & Golfhomes.com.
• Responsible for development of new features in existing application using PHP, MySQL and JavaScript.
• Working on development of Oracle mobile chatbot using Oracle Mobile cloud service.
• Responsible for building secure solution using Escapia homes and land api to solve complex problem of customer.
• Working with Escapia homes and land api to get updated data and display on websites accordingly.
• Working with rapid Agile and SCRUM-based projects to iterative technical design, implementation projects and systems integration.
• Leveraging JIRA to organize and execute engagements.
• Worked as a technical expert with clients, analysts and other team members to develop technical solutions to complex business problems.
• Designing, validating, and presenting software solutions to customer include advanced product concepts, future direction, and 3rd-party complimentary solution.
• Writing functional test-cases to make sure that we are not only writing working code but also the correct feature.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Worked directly with customer to establish project scope, interaction guidelines, and project timelines.
• Designed and Developed responsive web application using PHP, MySQL on a XAMP environment.
• Used JavaScript, jQuery and AJAX to provide elegant user interfaces.
• Developed and consumed RESTful as well as SOAP web services.
•  Worked on Node js on few of projects for making web applications.
• Utilized Google maps API and Paypal API for payment gateway integration.
• Worked on the team and individual development of projects to deliver secure, robust and scalable Database
positions.insights: Skills: Node.js · PHP · REST API · JavaScript · MySQL

positions.title: Tutoring
positions.description:
• Worked directly with instructors of Marshall university as an in class-tutor to aid their students.
• Conducted one on one sessions on Database, Java, PHP & JavaScript concepts for undergrad students.
• Helped the students on their academic project development.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Implemented agile methodology & software development life cycle (SDLC) from design, coding, development, maintenance, troubleshooting to quality analysis, testing and debugging.
• Used Php framework like WordPress and core Php to build dynamic web application.
• Resolved various critical bugs in the product to improve performance and help customer's to Go Live.
• Designed responsive & business applications using Bootstrap, HTML, Javascript and CSS based on the W3C standards.
• Troubleshoot and solved slow application of MySQL by indexing tables, rewriting queries and optimizing schema.
• Tested cross browser compatibility and Responsiveness of web pages and worked on different browsers.

• Conference management tool is an application for organizing and managing conferences in university
• Developed complete form based secure application using php & mysql and hosted on AWS with very useful cloud services like auto scalling and elastic load balancer.
• Used Responsive Web Design templates to meet cutting-edge technology requirements
• Developed UI screens using Bootstrap HTML & CSS, JavaScript for validations, and JQuery/AJAX for animations.

projects.title: Sales Analysis-Tableau
projects.description:
*Visual analytics project that allowed us to represent very large amount of data into meaningful manner. 
*I did complete analysis of data using different graphs and filters in Tableau software with country vise and year vise analysis.
*Created dashboard to display all the graphs and result onto one page for  better understanding of client.
